Dear Ms. Stone,

Re: Account reference: ACC-270128

We received your dispute letter regarding the account referenced above. We acknowledge your dispute and appreciate your attention to the accuracy of your credit report. We understand that you have disputed the reporting of late payment information on your credit report.

Pursuant to the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) and the South Carolina Consumer Protection Code, we will conduct an investigation into the matter. We will review the account history to determine the accuracy of the reported late payments. We will also verify the account information with our records and with Lakeshore Utilities, the original creditor.

We have reviewed the account history and found that the account was charged off on January 16, 2022, and the last payment was made on May 2, 2023. The current balance on the account is $790.19. We will investigate the dispute and respond to you in a timely manner.

Please note that our investigation may take some time to complete. We will provide you with the results of our investigation and any necessary corrections to your credit report. If we determine that the reported late payments were inaccurate, we will take steps to correct the error.

You have the right to dispute this matter further if you are not satisfied with the results of our investigation. You may also contact the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) or the South Carolina Attorney General's Office for assistance.

Sincerely,

Pinnacle Asset Management
